recovery.title: Recovery Phrase
recovery.warning: Write this down. It will NOT be shown again.
recovery.confirmDisabled: Verify all words above to continue
recovery.whyBody: This 24-word phrase is the ONLY way to recover your vault if every device fails. There is no server, no email reset, no phone number to call. If you lose the phrase and all your devices, your vault is gone forever.
recovery.example1: You buy a new laptop and your old one is already gone.
recovery.example2: Your phone is lost or destroyed and your laptop died last month.
recovery.example3: A house fire, flood, or theft takes every device at once.
recovery.example4: You return to Baluard after years away and need to set up a new device.
recovery.writeItDown: Write it on paper. Store it somewhere safe (safe, safety deposit box, fireproof bag). Screenshots and password managers are NOT safe enough — they can fail too.
recovery.verified: All words match. Your recovery phrase is saved.
recovery.sheetWarning: Anyone who can read these 24 words can open this vault. Store this file somewhere safe.
recovery.fileRisk: The file is saved without encryption. Keep it only on an encrypted or offline drive.

rotation.title: Recovery phrase
rotation.desc: The 24-word phrase is the only way to recover this vault if you lose your password. Keep it somewhere safe.
rotation.replacedNote: A fresh phrase is printed once; the old one stops working right away.
rotation.warning: Anyone who can read this phrase can read this vault. Store it before you close this window.
rotation.stored: I stored my new phrase somewhere safe
rotation.rotatedToast: Recovery phrase replaced. The old phrase no longer works.

recovery.kitBody: These 24 words open the vault when every admin device is gone. Shown once — keep them with the family kit.
recovery.kitSavedAck: I saved the kit phrase somewhere safe.
recovery.kitSheetWarning: Anyone holding these 24 words can open this vault. Store this file with the family kit, somewhere safe.

setup.title: Sync your vault
setup.subtitle: Optional: back up your vault and sync across devices
setup.whatIsSync: Sync stores an encrypted copy of your vault in your own Git repository. Your data stays encrypted end-to-end — only you can read it.
setup.benefits: Connect a provider to back up automatically and sync between your devices. You can always do this later in Settings.
setup.skipHint: You can set up sync anytime in Settings.
setup.synced: Sync enabled. Your vault will back up automatically.

vault.readOnlyOtherVault: This entry lives in {name}. Open that vault to make changes.
vault.emptyTrashConfirm: Permanently delete all entries in trash? This cannot be undone.

vaultSwitcher.unlockBody: Enter the master password to unlock this vault.

entry.repromptLocked: This entry is protected. Confirm your master password to show hidden values.

entry.deleteTagConfirm: This will remove the tag "{tag}" from all entries. The entries themselves will not be deleted.
entry.enterMasterPasswordToContinue: Enter your master password to continue.

settings.faviconDesc: Off by default. Turning this on fetches logos from each website, falling back to Google. Both services learn which sites you save. Only the first website in each entry is sent.
settings.trayOnlyDesc: Keep Baluard in the system tray only. The window stays reachable from the tray icon; closing it still hides to the tray.
settings.compatibleRenderingDesc: Fixes blank or glitched windows on some Linux systems. Automatic turns it on only when needed. Applies after you restart Baluard.
settings.promptQuickUnlock: Enter master password to enable Quick Unlock:
settings.quickUnlockDesc: Store unlock secret in OS keychain (biometric protected)
settings.quickUnlockSub: Unlock with biometric or device PIN
settings.title: App Settings
settings.autolockDesc: Automatically locks the vault after a period of inactivity.
settings.quickUnlockLongDesc: Store credentials securely in OS Keychain using device biometrics (fingerprint/face) or PIN code.
settings.quickUnlockNoReadGate: On this device, any program running as your user can read the stored master password without a prompt. Keep Quick Unlock enabled only if you trust this device.
settings.quickUnlockSharedWarning: Warning: anyone whose biometrics are enrolled on this device will be able to unlock this vault.
settings.pinSharedWarning: Warning: anyone who can unlock this device's screen will be able to unlock this vault with this PIN.
settings.importDesc: Select a source to import entries from.
settings.exportBackupHint: Everything, for backup or moving devices
settings.exportSpreadsheetHint: Logins only (.csv), for printing or other apps
settings.backupPassDesc: This passphrase is the only way to open the backup file. Losing it loses the backup forever. It is not your master password, and Baluard never stores it.
settings.backupPassImportDesc: Enter the passphrase you saved when you created this backup. It is not your master password.
settings.backupSavedAck: I saved this passphrase somewhere safe
settings.healthDesc: Scans this vault for weak, reused, and stale passwords.
settings.healthEmpty: No issues found. All entries look good.
settings.pinLongDesc: Unlock with a 6-digit PIN instead of the master password. After restarting the app you must unlock once with the master password, then the PIN works again. Disable it anytime in Settings.
settings.pinWarning: Warning: a PIN is less secure than your master password. It only protects this session, not against someone with your device.
settings.pinNeedPassword: Enter your master password to enable PIN unlock.
settings.profileDesc: Customize your identity in the sidebar.
settings.syncNotAvailable: Sync is not available on this build.
settings.hwKeyOn: This vault is guarded by your security key.
settings.hwKeyOff: This vault is not guarded by a security key.
settings.hwKeyEnableTitle: Turn on the security key guard?
settings.hwKeyEnableBody: A stolen disk or backup alone will no longer be able to open this vault, even with the password. If you lose the key, you will need the recovery phrase to open this vault again.
settings.hwKeyDisableTitle: Turn off the security key guard?
settings.hwTitle: Guard with this device's security chip
settings.hwDesc: A stolen disk or backup alone cannot open this vault, even with the password.
settings.hwOn: This vault is guarded by the security chip.
settings.hwOff: This vault is not guarded by the security chip.
settings.hwEnableTitle: Turn on the security chip guard?
settings.hwEnableBody: A stolen disk or backup alone will no longer be able to open this vault, even with the password. If this device's chip dies, this device will need the recovery phrase to rejoin, like any new device.
settings.hwDisableTitle: Turn off the security chip guard?
settings.hwDisableBody: Back to password-only protection: a stolen disk could be attacked offline. The vault still syncs and recovers as usual.
settings.hwConsentDesc: The chip asks for your fingerprint or face each time this vault opens. Stops someone who knows your password from opening it on this device.
settings.hwConsentOnTitle: Ask for confirmation on every unlock?
settings.hwConsentOnBody: Your device's security chip will ask for your fingerprint or face every time this vault is unlocked. Your vault stays encrypted either way. If the chip dies or biometry is reset, the recovery phrase brings this device back in.
settings.hwConsentOffBody: The security chip keeps the vault encrypted when locked, but unlocking will no longer ask for your fingerprint or face.
settings.hwConsentOnToast: The chip will confirm every unlock.
settings.hwTouchBodyName: Touch the key when it blinks to guard "{name}". Waiting for your touch…
settings.hwTouchBody: Touch the key when it blinks. Waiting for your touch…
settings.hwAttestUnknownShort: Key maker could not be verified; the key still works.
settings.hwAttestUnknownToast: This key is not verified as Yubico-made. Baluard accepted it: the guard still needs your password and this key.

sync.title: Vault Sync
sync.description: Connect to a git provider to sync your vault across devices.
sync.disconnectConfirm: Remove the git remote from this vault? Your data stays local.
sync.disconnectRevokeToken: Also revoke provider token (affects all vaults)
sync.disconnectConfirmDeleteRemoteDesc: I understand this will permanently delete the remote repository on the provider. This action is irreversible.
sync.disconnectDeleteFailed: Disconnected, but the remote repository could not be deleted (your token may lack delete permissions). Delete it manually on the provider.
sync.disconnectDeleteFailedWithUrl: Disconnected, but the remote repository could not be deleted (your token may lack delete permissions). Delete it manually: {url}
sync.deviceFlowInstructions: Visit the link below and enter the code:
sync.errorIntegrityFailure: Signature verification failed. The remote repository may have been tampered with.
sync.warningDescription: Your git remote is configured but the provider token is missing or expired.
sync.advancedOptionsHint: Override the OAuth app or point at a self-hosted instance. Leave blank for the defaults.
sync.advancedPatPlaceholder: Paste a PAT to bypass the automatic flow
sync.advancedPatHint: More secure on Codeberg: use the write:repository scope.
sync.codebergFullAccessWarning: Codeberg OAuth2 has no scope support. Authorizing Baluard grants it full access to your Codeberg account. For tighter access, create a Personal Access Token with the write:repository scope under Advanced options instead.
sync.webOAuthInstructions: Your browser will open. Authorize Baluard and return here.
sync.webOAuthWaiting: Waiting for authorization in your browser...
sync.errorRepoCreatePartial: Repository may have been created on the provider but sync setup failed. If you give up, you may need to delete the empty repo on {provider} manually.
sync.migrateTitle: Move sync to a new address
sync.migrateConfirmBody: Everyone you share with is told about the new address and follows on their next sync. Move now?
sync.migratedToast: Sync moved. Everyone follows on their next sync.
sync.customWarn: A custom server means you manage it: repository creation, clone access for members, and removal all happen on the server by hand. Baluard stores the credentials only on this device.
sync.customAck: I understand I manage this server myself
sync.customGenKeyHint: Give the public key to your server by hand
sync.customTrustTitle: This server's identity is not saved yet. Compare the security code with what your server shows, then confirm:
sync.customTrustOtherType: This host already has a key of another type on file.
sync.customChangedBody: This server's identity changed since you last connected, so the app blocked the connection to protect you. Check with the server's administrator before doing anything: if the change was not expected, someone may be pretending to be your server.
sync.customBadUrl: That does not look like a repository URL.

autosync.offline: Offline. Changes will sync when back online

conflict.explanation: You edited this on {local} and on {remote}. We can't tell which one is right. Pick a version, or keep both to be safe.

keepLocal.title: Keep this device's version

keepRemote.title: Keep the other device's version

keepBoth.title: Keep both as separate items

conflict.resolveFailed: We couldn't save that decision. Try again or pick a different option.

people.inviteHint: Share this one-time code with the person you want to invite. It works for a single join.

people.resetBody: Reset {name}'s access? They re-join with a new invite and their entries are kept.
people.transferBody: Make {name} the owner? You become an admin. This can be transferred back later.
people.overrideLabel: Remove anyway even if the download access could not be revoked
people.seatUnstruck: Warning: their download access could not be revoked:

people.claimBody: Take ownership from {name}? They become an admin and can be made owner again later.
people.replaceBody: Reset {name}'s membership with a replacement invite that carries their shared folders, revoke their devices, and rotate what they could open. Their old device stops working.
people.replaceResultBody: Shown once. The member rejoins with this code and keeps their shared folders.
people.replaceWarn: Some steps failed — the old device may still hold old keys:
people.resetCodeBody: Send this one-time code to the member. They re-join with it and set a new password.
people.sharingSubtitle: Share securely with family, friends or teams, and work organizations. Create separate shared spaces for each group you belong to.
people.membersLegacy: Sharing is not set up on this vault yet.
people.reviewHint: Run the review to see who can see what — roles, shared folders, and what removed people could still read.

people.reviewKeptBytes: Removed people keep the bytes they already read — entries above are what to rotate.
people.timelineEmpty: History appears as the vault changes.
people.verifyDesc: Compare this code with the one their Baluard shows under their verification code. A match confirms identity.
people.verifyMissing: No contact card for this member yet.
people.demoteBody: Demoting {name} removes their admin access immediately. They keep their account and current entry access, but can no longer manage members, keys, or shared folders.
people.contestBody: {claimant} claimed ownership from the current owner. It takes effect on {date} unless the owner cancels it.
people.contestHint: This notice reaches every admin device on its next sync.
people.contestCancelBody: The claim disappears and the current owner stays the owner. The claiming admin sees the change on their next sync.

join.noVault: Select the shared vault first (add it via its clone link).
join.codePlaceholder: Paste the invite code you received

join.introHint: Your join request — copy and send it to the owner

collections.deleteBody: Delete {name}? Entries in it keep existing, but they stop being shared.
collections.catalogTitle: Show shared folders when people ask
collections.catalogSubtitle: Publishes shared folder names so people can pick one when asking for access. Only names are shown.
collections.catalogClearConfirm: Members asking for access will no longer see shared folder names; they can still paste an id. Clear the published list?

share.title: Share entry
share.subtitle: Create a shared file for {name}. The recipient opens it without an account.
share.separateChannels: Send the file and the passphrase by different channels. Anyone with both can read this entry until it expires.
share.openSubtitle: Pick the shared file you received.
share.passphraseRequired: This file needs the one-time passphrase.
share.fileTooLarge: That file is too large to be a shared item.

share.noContactsHint: No contacts yet — add one in Settings > Contacts first.

contacts.importPlaceholder: Paste the contact code you received
contacts.noWrapKey: Old card: ask them to share it again to receive items
contacts.removeBody: Remove {name} from your contacts? Items they already received are unaffected.

outbox.sharedHint: Live mirrors: items update in the recipient’s folder when you change them.
outbox.pathHint: For multiple recipients, each gets a separate subfolder inside this folder.
outbox.revokeBody: Stop mirroring to this folder? Copies the recipient already has stay with them.
outbox.forgetBody: Remove this folder from your list? The files stay on disk.

space.inviteAuthorityDesc: Admins and owners, or owners only. Does not affect reset invitations.
space.viewerExportDesc: Viewers can download a copy of the vault. Off by default.
space.guestDesc: Create share links that open without an account. Already-created links keep working until they expire.
space.trashPolicyDesc: Who can move entries to the trash. Restore is always admin-only.
space.restorePolicyDesc: Bringing a trashed entry back is reserved for admins in this version.
space.teamOn: On. Members see only what is shared with them.
space.teamOff: Right now every device in this vault holds every key. Team mode keeps personal entries on admin devices private.
space.teamMissing: {n} member(s) need to open Baluard and sign in once before you can turn this on.
space.rotatePrompt: Team mode is on. Rotate the vault key now — until you do, members who joined earlier still hold the old key.
space.teamConfirmBody: This is one-way. Members keep access to entries shared with them and lose sight of everything else, starting from their next unlock. Type “team” to confirm.
space.joinApprovalDesc: Approve new members manually, or let a valid invite code approve itself.
space.quorumDesc: How many admins must confirm sensitive actions: removals, resets, transfers, key rotation, moving the sync address.
space.policyPublished: Published — {n} recommendation(s); members see them as hints
space.kitDesc: A 24-word phrase that can re-open this vault if every admin device is lost. The phrase works even without this app.
space.kitPhraseWarn: Shown once. Store them offline (a safe, not a notes app). Whoever holds them can open this vault.
space.kitConfirmBody: Without the kit, losing every admin device and the recovery phrase means the vault cannot be reopened. You can set a kit up again later.
space.createAuthDesc: By default only admins create shared folders.

groups.subtitle: A group is a list of people — like a department. Give the whole group access to a shared folder at once. When someone leaves the group, they keep what they already copied; nothing new opens for them.
groups.deleteBody: Delete "{name}"? Entries stay; the group's access to shared folders ends.
groups.removeNote: Removing someone re-keys the group: what they already opened stays open to them, but future group access ends.

removal.bodyConfirmed: You were removed from this vault. It no longer syncs on this device.
removal.bodyReset: The owner reset this device's access. It no longer syncs on this device.
removal.bodyProbable: This Vault may have removed this device — sync keeps failing with an access error.

removal.detachAction: Remove from this app (keep the files)
removal.detachedToast: Removed from this app. The files stay on disk.

legacy.notArmed: Legacy Contact is not set up for this vault.
legacy.wasClosed: Legacy Contact is off. You can set it up again.
legacy.windowLabel: How long should your silence last before the kit opens?

legacy.letterPlaceholder: Dear Ana, if you are reading this…
legacy.passphraseHint: The kit opens only with this passphrase. Send it separately from the kit.
legacy.savedIt: I saved the passphrase somewhere safe
legacy.armedQuiet: Legacy Contact is armed. The kit opens after {days} days of silence.
legacy.windowElapsed: The silence window has elapsed. Your contact can now ask to reach the vault copy.
legacy.silenceSoFar: {days} days have passed since your last unlock.
legacy.bannerOpen: Your trusted contact can now ask to reach the vault copy.
legacy.kitDesc: Save this file and send it to your contact out of band, along with the passphrase.

legacy.disarmBody: The kit stops working and the vault keeps its current key. You can set it up again later.

legacy.openNotAKit: That file is not a Baluard kit letter.
legacy.replaceBtn: Hand the kit to someone new
